BR-54
BRAKE -- ABSACTUATOR
INSTALLATION
Installation is in the reverse order of removal (See page BR-53).
HINT:
• After installation, fill the brake reservoir with brake fluid and bleed brake system (See page BR-4).
• Check for leaks.
